title: A user who can only view work orders sees the field as plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in at the test location as a user whose role has "Work Orders — View" but not "Work Orders — Create & Edit".
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep A.
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative field.
  2. Click the field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The field shows as plain text: "Sales Representative" with sales rep A under it.
  • There is no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x.

Step 2:

  • Nothing opens.
  • The field cannot be changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-N1: “A user without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit', or a work order that is invoiced, paid or opened from its history, shows the field as plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. If a change is sent by any other route, the system refuses it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
